text:
### Key Dates
| Event | Timeline |
|-------|----------|
| Account Activation | Immediate (online/branch) or 5–7 days (postal) |
| First Interest Payment | End of month following opening |
| Password Reset Link Sent | Within 24 hours |
| Card Arrival (if applicable) | 3–5 business days |
name: Chunk 15/23

raw_entities.name: Account Activation Timeline
raw_entities.description: Guidance on account activation timelines for customers opening accounts through different channels. Online and branch activations are immediate, while postal applications take 5–7 days.

raw_entities.name: First Interest Payment
raw_entities.description: Customer guidance on when the first interest payment is credited to the account following opening. Interest is paid at the end of the month following account opening.
context: First Interest Payment | End of month following opening

raw_entities.name: Password Reset Link Delivery
raw_entities.description: Guidance on the timeline for password reset link delivery to customers. Reset links are sent within 24 hours of request.
context: Password Reset Link Sent | Within 24 hours

raw_entities.name: Card Arrival Timeline
raw_entities.description: Customer guidance on the expected delivery timeframe for payment cards issued with accounts. Cards arrive within 3–5 business days of issuance.
